Maya (docs): Heads-up: small link-fix PR is stuck because our "preview-site" check is required and takes ~18m. Any lightweight idea to speed up docs-only edits?

Alex (devex): We can add a short gate: `docs-lite` that runs fast and verifies changed files are markdown/images and optionally runs a link checker. Make the heavy preview optional.

Ravi (infra): GitHub branch protection only knows check names, not file types. Two patterns: create a fast required check, or have the preview job itself auto-pass for docs-only PRs. I prefer the fast required check approach.

Maya (docs): Fast check sounds safe. We still want runnable examples validated. Could authors annotate files that need a full render?

Alex (devex): Yep. Proposal: authors add `<!-- needs-render -->` to files that update live examples/snippets. `docs-lite` will fail if it finds that marker and force `preview-site`. Otherwise `docs-lite` passes in <30s.

Maya (docs): Nice. Add CONTRIBUTING note about the marker so teams remember.

Ravi (infra): Implementation notes: `docs-lite` action will: 1) fetch PR file list, 2) if any non-doc files -> exit 1 (to trigger full preview), 3) run a grep for `needs-render`, 4) run basic link-check (broken links fail). If any step fails, action returns non-zero so `preview-site` must run.

Alex (devex): I'll draft `.github/workflows/docs-lite.yml` and a tiny test harness to run locally. Example snippet for file-list check: ```bash
files=$(jq -r '.pull_request.files[].filename' < "$GITHUB_EVENT_PATH")
for f in $files; do
  case "$f" in
    *.md|*.mdx|images/*|static/*) ;;
    *) echo "non-doc change: $f"; exit 1;;
  esac

done
```

Maya (docs): Also update CODEOWNERS note so reviewers know. No ownership change, just docs.

gh-actions-bot: PR opened: #4420 alex/devex/docs-lite-check -- checks: docs-lite (running), lint (ok)

Ravi (infra): Minor addition: include a step to ensure no `<!-- experimental-example -->` markers slip through; we should treat that as needs-render too.

Alex (devex): good call. I'll include both markers.

Maya (docs): thanks y'all. If this lands, we can merge many tiny fixes without waiting the full preview. :sparkles:
